name: AutoGen (Microsoft)
shortDescription: Microsoft open-source Python library for multi-agent conversations. Newest release we found is from 2025.
longDescription: AutoGen (the microsoft/autogen Python library) is a multi-agent framework. We installed autogen-agentchat and imported it, with no model call. The latest Python GitHub release we found, python-v0.7.5, was published on September 30, 2025 — older than the other frameworks in this check. Treat freshness as an open question, not a verdict.
pricingNotes: No SaaS pricing page for the framework. Latest GitHub python release python-v0.7.5 dated 2025-09-30 — older than peers; industry notes mention Microsoft Agent Framework as successor — flag for catalog freshness.
freeTierNotes: Open-source library; no product paywall for the framework itself (LLM provider costs separate).
bestFor: Teams that want an open-source library with no product paywall
notIdealFor: Anyone who needs a 2026 release cadence — we did not find one
smokeTestNotes: Install/import only; no API key, no LLM invoke, no signup.
problems: Latest Autogen python release on GitHub is 2025-09-30; may be maintenance-mode relative to newer Microsoft Agent Framework.
